name: zalo-social-mcp
description: Zalo (social): me, publish_text, publish_image, delete. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_zalo_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_APP_ID
platform_mcp_zalo_app_id.description: ID of your Zalo app (developers.zalo.me > app > Thông tin ứng dụng).

platform_mcp_zalo_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_zalo_secret_key.description: The app's secret key (Khóa bí mật của ứng dụng); sent only as the secret_key header of the token request.

platform_mcp_zalo_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_zalo_refresh_token.description: OA refresh_token from the OA authorisation (POST https://oauth.zaloapp.com/v4/oa/access_token with grant_type=authorization_code). Valid 3 months and single-use: each refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set). Access tokens last 25 h.

platform_mcp_zalo_author.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_AUTHOR
platform_mcp_zalo_author.description: Author name shown on OA articles (≤50 characters).

platform_mcp_zalo_cover_photo_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALO_COVER_PHOTO_URL
platform_mcp_zalo_cover_photo_url.description: URL of the cover photo used for text articles (the article API requires a cover).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2.0/oa/getoa: the OA's id, name, description, is_verified, num_follower, package.

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: POST /v2.0/article/create (type normal, status show) publishes an OA article whose title, description and body are `text` — so `text` must be ≤150 characters (title limit; description ≤300) — with the configured author and cover photo. Creation is asynchronous: the returned `id` is the creation token; POST /v2.0/article/verify {token} gives the article id that delete takes. reply_to is ignored.

tools.name: publish_image
tools.description: POST /v2.0/article/create: an OA article with `text` as title/description/first paragraph (≤150 characters; required here) and the FIRST of `image_urls` as both cover and image paragraph (further URLs are ignored: the adapter cannot emit a variable number of paragraphs). `id` is the creation token (resolve with /v2.0/article/verify).

tools.name: delete
tools.description: POST /v2.0/article/remove {id}: deletes an OA article by its article id (from /v2.0/article/verify or /v2.0/article/getslice).
